remarks: This light filled two bedroom townhouse at Middlesex Commons is in a premier park like setting . A two story pavilion of windows offers a serene environment overlooking beautiful landscaping and a water feature. The open living/ dining area has a fireplace, and sliders to the spacious deck for outdoor enjoyment. The kitchen has a light filled dining area.Upstairs are two generous en suite bedrooms with high ceilings ,and an office nook overlooking the gardens. The pool and pool house are just steps away. A guest cottage on the property can be rented for visitors. Shopping, dining, parks, library and train are all conveniently located just outside Middlesex Commons. Life could not be easier or more enjoyable.
